text:
Predicates:
GrewUpInHealthyHome(x) ::: x grew up in a health-conscious childhood home.
EatsSalad(x) ::: x eats salads regularly.
ConsciousAboutHealth(x) ::: x is very conscious about their health and eating habits.
GoodRelationshipWithParents(x) ::: x has a good relationship with their parents.
FulfillsNutritionalIntake(x) ::: x fulfills their nutritional daily intakes.
VisitsGym(x) ::: x visits the gym at least once a day.
Taylor ::: the individual Taylor.

Premises:
∀x (EatsSalad(x) → ConsciousAboutHealth(x)) ::: All people who eat salads regularly are very conscious about their health and eating habits.
∀x (GrewUpInHealthyHome(x) → EatsSalad(x)) ::: All people who grew up in health-conscious childhood homes eat salads regularly.
∀x (FulfillsNutritionalIntake(x) → GrewUpInHealthyHome(x)) ::: All people who fulfill their nutritional daily intakes grew up in health-conscious childhood homes.
∀x (GoodRelationshipWithParents(x) → FulfillsNutritionalIntake(x)) ::: If people have good relationships with their parents, then they fulfill their nutritional daily intakes.
∀x (GoodRelationshipWithParents(x) → ¬EatsSalad(x)) ::: If people have good relationships with their parents, then they do not eat salads regularly.
∀x (VisitsGym(x) → FulfillsNutritionalIntake(x)) ::: If people visit the gym at least once a day, then they always fulfill their daily nutritional intakes.
( (GrewUpInHealthyHome(Taylor)) ∧ (GoodRelationshipWithParents(Taylor)) ) ∨ ( ¬GrewUpInHealthyHome(Taylor) ∧ ¬GoodRelationshipWithParents(Taylor) ) ::: It is either both true that Taylor grew up in a health-conscious childhood home and she has a good relationship with her parents, or it is true that Taylor neither grew up in a health-conscious childhood home nor has a good relationship with her parents.

Conclusion:
¬GrewUpInHealthyHome(Taylor) ∧ ¬VisitsGym(Taylor) ::: Taylor neither grew up in a health-conscious childhood home nor does she visit the gym at least once a day.
